concept_evolve.py.purpose: Cross-domain concept-tree exploration pipeline. Launches OpenCode sub-agents to generate concept cards, build semantic bridge graphs, and manage a tree of concept folders on disk.

commands.evolve: Full pipeline: research a topic, generate 10+ concept cards, build semantic bridge graph, produce introspection and steering directions. Writes concept_cards.json, semantic_bridge.json, introspection.json, steering_directions.json plus per-concept tree folders.
commands.probe: Deep-dive into a specific bottleneck. Generates forced bridges to distant domains, anomaly analysis, steering directions, and validation checks. Writes probe_result.json.
commands.reframe: Reframes a problem across 8+ distinct domains with key insights, suggested techniques, and mapping back. Writes reframings.json.
commands.walk: Traverses the concept graph built by evolve. Filters by seed, limits depth (1-8). Writes walk_session.json.

output_schemas.concept_cards.json: Array of {symbolic_name, description, domains, mathematical_formalization, analogical_connections, implementation_hypothesis, experiment_seed, folder_plan}
output_schemas.tree/walk_paths.json: Pre-computed walk paths through concept tree

semantic_scholar.py.purpose: Robust Semantic Scholar API client for literature search, citation graph traversal, recommendations, and BibTeX export. Includes exponential backoff with 6 retries.

commands.search: Keyword search for papers, returns array of paper objects with paperId, title, year, authors, venue, abstract, etc.
commands.citations: Get papers that cite a given paper by paperId
commands.references: Get papers referenced by a given paper
commands.recommend: Get recommendations based on positive paper IDs (POST to recommendations endpoint)
commands.graph: Build citation graph: search for root papers then expand with references and citations. Returns {seed_query, root_count, node_count, edge_count, nodes, edges}
commands.bibtex: Generate BibTeX @article entry for a paper, resolving ArXiv/DOI URLs

opencode.json.purpose: OpenCode platform configuration defining model (claude-opus-4-6), providers, global permissions, and agent roles with tool permissions.

logs/.purpose: Execution logs directory containing orchestrator.log and researcher attempt logs in structured JSON format.

agents/concept-tree-explorer.md.purpose: Subagent for traversing concept trees and identifying high-value concept paths. Read-only (no write/edit permissions).

agents/literature-graph-miner.md.purpose: Subagent for mining citation graphs for transferable ideas and supporting evidence. Read-only.

tools/concept_evolve.ts.purpose: OpenCode tool wrapper calling .archivara/concept_evolve.py via execFileSync. Commands: evolve/probe/reframe/walk. Timeout: 20 min.

tools/semantic_scholar.ts.purpose: OpenCode tool wrapper calling .archivara/semantic_scholar.py via execFileSync. Appends --json for non-bibtex commands.

probe.schema: {associations, forced_bridges: [{from, to, mechanism}], anomaly_results, steering_directions, validation_checks, sub_problem, timestamp}

reframe.schema: {problem, framings: [{domain, reframing, key_insight, suggested_technique, mapping_back, candidate_folder_name}], timestamp}

walk.schema: {timestamp, seed, depth, total_paths, selected_paths, paths, concept_index_size}

semantic_scholar_api.paper_object_schema: {paperId, title, year, citationCount, authors, venue, abstract, externalIds, url}
semantic_scholar_api.resilience: Exponential backoff, 6 retries, 20s timeout per request

researcher.description: Execution-heavy research worker with full toolset

concept_worker.description: ConceptEvolve sub-worker spawned by concept_evolve.py (no recursion)
